batting.name: MS Bisla
batting.dismissal: c GH Vihari b KV Sharma

batting.name: CL White
batting.dismissal: c YK Pathan b JH Kallis

batting.name: KC Sangakkara
batting.dismissal: c MK Tiwary b R Bhatia

batting.name: DB Ravi Teja
batting.dismissal: c MK Tiwary b SP Narine

batting.name: GH Vihari
batting.dismissal: c MK Tiwary b R Bhatia

balls.text: another good ball, almost yorker length, digs it out past the bowler, wants to come back for the second but is caught well short, that's gone, just the single in the end
yorker length outside off, Kallis tries to dig it out but misses, good comeback from Ishant after that boundary
shortish on the off, pulls it towards deep midwicket for a single
full toss, driven towards long-off for just the single
Kallis finds the gap, bowled on a length and he swings it between deep midwicket and long-on for a one bounce four
full toss and Yusuf mistimes that one just past the bowler for a single
back of a length, Kallis pulls that wide of long-on for a couple of runs, Yusuf will take strike in the final over
ooh, drops it short outside off, tries to pull, gets a top edge but it lands safe into the off side, they get a single

run-out, Kallis swings, gets an inside edge onto the pads, Morgan calls for a single, Steyn runs to the ball, collects and under-arms the throw to the stumps at the striker's end, Morgan is short, shakes his head as he walks back, he's played a lovely cameo here
four more for Kallis, tries to go downtown but gets a thick outside edge past the keeper to the third-man boundary, Steyn smiles
on a length outside off, mistimes it this time to midwicket for a single
Morgan has flat-batted that for six over Steyn's head, short of a good length and that's hammered over the long-off boundary
too wide from Steyn, a slower ball gone bad, called one by the umpire
down the leg side and he'll feel he missed out there, gets a leg-bye as he tries to swing it over square leg
short and he's picked the gap on the off side this time, cut away over point, there is a fielder in the deep there but it's beaten him
down the leg side and it's called a wide, again more round-arm
poor bowling from Perera, another slower ball that landed halfway down the pitch and Morgan dragged it hard between long-on and deep midwicket
Perera bowled that more round-arm than he usually does, more a Malinga this time, was a low full toss and Morgan hit it clean through the line, over the bowler's head for six more
the offcutter again but a long hop as well, Morgan seizes the length early and bludgeons that one flat between deep midwicket and deep square leg, landed just inside the ropes
Morgan comes down the track and chops that offcutter past point for a couple of runs
punished, was the low full toss, Kallis made a bit of room and drilled it into that gap between deep extra cover and long-off
point could have done a better job there, full outside off, Kallis made room there and sliced it past the diving point fielder for four
short and it's pulled, lands short of deep midwicket, gets to him on the bounce, just the single
Morgan scampers back for the second, guided that one wide of third man and rushed back for two, took on the fielder in the deep, Mishra was the man
full outside off, a touch too wide, Morgan had to reach for that one and missed, called a wide
bowled on a length, Kallis swings it down to deep square leg for a single
short of a good length outside off, Kallis chops that into the ground towards point
the googly again, just punches that past midwicket into the deep for a single
was the googly, cut towards deep point for a single
Morgan tries to sweep that one square, gets an inside edge through the keeper's legs for a boundary
Morgan's launched that over long-on, tossed up and he reached forward to sky that over long-on, didn;t come off the middle but the connection was good enough to take it all the way
Morgan looks to reverse-sweep that past short third, can't make contact, was full outside off
floating it on middle, flicks it through square leg for a single
Morgan compensates somewhat for the spate of dot balls this over, short outside off and he  played that smartly, late-cuts it past the diving keeper for the third-man boundary, used the pace there
excellent over from Steyn, Morgan is cramped for room there, chops it towards point, is not allowed a single
shortish on leg stump, tried to work that through square leg, was struck high on the pads there
slower one bowled short outside off, tried to cut, missed
goodish length, on target from Steyn, Morgan defends that one solidly towards cover
short of a good length outside off, cut away into the deep for a single
the legcutter again, short on the off, Morgan pushes it back to the bowler
full outside off and he's off the mark immediately, square-driving it past point into the deep for a couple of runs
Reddy gets Gambhir! Almost yorker length, Gambhir seemed to have made up his mind there, tried to go over the top of midwicket, missed it and the off stump was knocked out
the legcutter, gets a thick inside edge as he tries to drive that past the bowler
Kallis goes hard at that one, connects superbly, pitched on a length and he creams that through extra cover, massive gap in the deep and he finds it
the slower legcutter from Reddy, Gambhir drives that one to long-off for a single
nicely done by Kallis, shortish outside off and Kallis opened the face at just the right time, third man is a little square and Kallis guided this well past him for a boundary
didn't get hold of that one, Perera angled it towards middle and leg and Gambhir got it high on the bat, just the single to long-on
short and wide and Gambhir goes hard at that one, only to miss it
that took forever to get to him, was the slower legcutter, Kallis picked it at the right time and pulled it through square leg for a single
angling in towards middle, tickles it past square leg for a single
Kallis dabs that one in front of point to collect a single
slower one bowled full outside off, tries to open the face again, misses
smartly done, was a full toss outside off, Gambhir reached for it and guided it wide of short third man for a boundary to bring up his half-century
sliding on the pads, slower one this time, chips it into the leg side for a single
pitched up on the pads, Gambhir swings well towards deep midwicket for a single
slightly short on the off, punches that through point into the deep for a single
pitched up and Kallis drives that one straight towards extra cover
that's been turned into the leg side for a single
shortish on the off, rocks on the back foot and punches it towards deep extra cover for a single
short of a good length outside off and Gambhir misses out on a cut
slower one but bowled down the leg side, misses, called a wide
slower one on the off, drops it in front of point, they steal a quick single
tickled it towards short fine leg for a single
slower one bowled short on leg stump, Gambhir gets a leading edge as he tries to turn the face, lands in front of the bowler
slightly short, gets on the back foot and punches it towards the bowler
shortish outside off, cuts it past point into the deep for a single
slog-sweep again and he clears the ropes comfortably, fetches it from outside off and deposits it behind the wide long-on boundary, connected superbly
slightly short on the off, guides that one to point again
short and flat outside off, Gambhir cuts that one straight to point
floating it on middle, Kallis knocks it away into the leg side for a single
superbly done, quicker through the air, bowled on middle and Gambhir bisected that gap between long-on and deep midwicket with a slog-sweep
the googly, turned away from outside off, Gambhir thought of the cut and then backed out
shorter on the off, late-cuts it towards short third, can't beat the gap there
lands full on the off and Gambhir drills it back down the pitch to Mishra
tossed up on the off, drives it in the direction of long-off for a single
flighted on the off, Gambhir comes down the track and pushes it towards long-off for a single
on the off stump, turned away past square leg for a single
gets front and across and clips it behind short fine for a couple of runs
Bisla holes out, Karan Sharma strikes, flatter from Karan, Bisla charged out and clipped it straight into the hands of deep midwicket
shortish outside off, guided behind point for a single
tries to play it with the turn into the leg side, strikes him on the pads
lands on the pads, flicked away into the leg side for a single
flatter on the off, he's pushed that back towards the bowler
lovely shot, tossed up, he stepped out of the crease, got to the pitch and lofted it elegantly over extra cover for a one bounce four
picked the gap, raises the fifty with a boundary, comes down the track and smacks it over midwicket
ooh, too late to cut there, that turned in from the off, was playing it right in front of middle, managed to chop it towards point just at the right time
flatter outside off, opens the face to play it towards short third
slightly short on middle, works it away through to deep midwicket for a single
shortish outside off, cuts it towards point form the crease
lucky, short and he was looking to drag that, got an inside edge just past the stumps towards fine leg for a single
slightly short on middle, turns it towards midwicket from the crease
dropped that one short outside off, good carry through to the keeper, Bisla tried to upper-cut that but missed
width again but Gambhir doesn't get it as square, cuts it down to third man for a single
that's been dispatched, short and wide from Ishant and that's been punished through point for a boundary
shortish on the off, knocks that one down in front of point for a quick single
shortish outside off and he runs that down towards third man for a single
good response, banged it short on middle and Bisla let that one go by ducking under
easily done, made room again while simultaneously stepping out of the crease and just smacked him over extra cover
found the gap superbly there, short of a length, made room and cracked it well between cover and point for a boundary
that's bowled short and Gambhir misses out on the pull, tries to smack it through square leg, struck high on the pads
tried to open the face there but didn't make contact, just went past the outside edge
Bisla had made up his mind, charged out and just chipped that over mid-on for a boundary
beaten, bowled at 141.6kmph according to the IPL speedometer, short of a good length and may have moved away a hint, Bisla played a little inside the line and was beaten
short on leg stump and he went for the pull, got it high on the pads and they pick a leg-bye
slightly short on middle, gets on the back foot and knocks it away into the off side
Gambhir makes room to crack that through cover, got an inside edge and scampered back for the second as it rolled towards fine leg
slightly short, guides that one towards point for a quick single
slightly short on the off, rocks back and punches that one to extra cover
nips away after pitching, opened the face at the right time and guided it towards third man for a single
pitched on a length and Gambhir tried to go over the top, lofted it over extra cover but didn't get good hold of it, just two more
slightly short on middle, gets on the back foot and turns it just wide of midwicket for a single
bowled on a good length on middle, pushes it towards the bowler
slog-sweep, mistimed, flighted it outside off and he managed to pierce it through midwicket for a boundary
floating it outside off, pushes it towards cover from the crease
gives it plenty of air, tossed up outside off, drives it through cover into the deep for a single, an overthrow and they pick up one more

struck him in line, appeal for lbw, may have pitched outside leg, ooh, appears to have just pitched in line, marginal call there, he tried to turn the face and missed the ball, close call, really close
there is a long-on in place but he picked his gap, tossed up, landed on a length and he swung it in the wide long-on area for a one-bounce four
goes round the wicket to the right-hander, floating it full on middle and Bisla sweeps it hard through square leg for four
angling in towards middle, turns it wide of the diving Mishra at mid-on for a single
back of a length outside off, runs that one down to third man for a single
makes a bit of room to force that through the off side, gets a thick inside edge towards fine leg for a single
slightly short on middle, rocks on the back foot and punches it towards mid-off
beaten, short of a good length on the off and it moves away, Bisla flirts with that one and is lucky not to get an edge
angling in towards middle, rocks forward and plays it back to the bowler
swing and a miss and it's all over
slower one, punched towards long-off for a single
crunched past extra cover for a single
down the leg side and that's a wide, the keeper fumbles as well
Vihari has holed out, slower one and he swings that straight into Tiwary's hands at long-on, flat hit, but Tiwary took it comfortably
pitched up, chips it wide of long-on for just the single
the offcutter, swing and a miss, cuts away as he was trying to go over midwicket
plays it towards short third man for a single, Kallis ends an outstanding spell, he's my pick for Man of the Match
on a good length, guides that one down to third man for a single
the leg stump has been knocked out, Perera swung hard at that one, was eyeing cow corner, missed and heard the death rattle
slower one bowled on leg stump, turns it past square leg for a single
shortish outside off, makes room to cut it past point, misses
shortish on the off, cracks towards long-on for a single
tries to guide it past point, plays it down towards the keeper instead
gets an inside edge as he tries to swing it towards leg, a single
slightly short on the off, runs it towards short third for a quick single
quicker, full on leg and that's been driven down towards long-on for a single
too little too late, short outside off and it's flat-batted over the bowler's end, wide of long-on, for a boundary
fires it full on leg stump, tries to force it past midwicket, gets an inside edge on to his pads
bowled'im! Slower through the air, Reddy came down to track to swing this over midwicket, it turned in, he missed and was bowled through the gate
drives that between long-on and deep midwicket for a couple of runs

dropped, really tough chance though, Perera tried to go over midwicket, got a leading edge and it was in the air for some time, Senanayake had to run back, kept his eyes on it but it just evaded him as he reached for it as it landed
strikes the umpire as he hits it back past the bowler, just the single
turns in from outside off, makes room to cut that square, misses
slides it on the pads from over the wicket, Perera tries to swing it fine, gets a leg-bye
full toss and it's been pulled into the deep towards deep midwicket for a single
the carrom ball, guided it towards short third man for a single, the keeper seemed to have got a glove to it as well
struck flat wide of long-on, Morgan sees it fine this time, a single
Tiwary snaps another one, Ravi Teja had little choice, tried to go big, that went on straight and he didn't get hold of it, skied it towards long-on where Tiwary, who ran in, took a well-judged catch
drags that from the off stump, wide of long-on for just the single
short, good bounce for Narine, pulled wide of deep square leg for a couple of runs
full on middle, turns it through square leg, just the single, excellent over from Balaji
flicked away stylishly towards fine leg where Rajat Bhatia cuts it off, just the single
Perera cracks that from the off towards deep midwicket for a single
Ravi Teja swivels and whips that towards fine leg for just the single
lands safely in the vacant midwicket region, slower one bowled short again, he mistimes it, just gets the single
slower one from Balaji and Perera has a big swing at that one, misses as it cuts away
thick outside edge as he tries to drive that through cover, edges it to short third, Perera wants to keep strike for the final over
this one turns away, slaps it towards deep cover for one more
shortish outside off, chops that one past point into the deep for a couple of runs

Morgan missed it in the floodlights! That was struck flat and he seemed to get under it to complete what would have been a comfortable catch, but, at the last moment, he was distracted by the glare and completely missed the ball
Perera clears that by a long distance, tossed up on the off and he sends that miles behind the deep midwicket boundary
cut away through point into the deep for a single
slower one bowled short outside off, drags it down to fine leg for a single
Perera pulls this one hard, to the left of deep midwicket this time, just the single this time
gets on the back foot and pushes it past the bowler for a single
Perera takes it from the off stump and jabs it through midwicket, it's dragged back in by Shukla who dives to his right in the deep, three to Perera
strikes him high on the pads as he tries to whip it square, a leg-bye
slower one again, shortish on leg stump, worked away through square leg for a single
gets back and clips it through square leg for a couple more runs, steady progress but not enough for the target they're trying to chase down
yorker length on leg stump, plays it away through midwicket for one more
gets on the back foot and whips it wide of long-on for a single
slower one bowled full on middle, drives that down to long-off for a single
slower one bowled short outside off, cracked towards deep cover for a single

Sunrisers are in trouble! Slower one and he went flat at that one, tried to clear long-off but could not, didn't time it well either, Tiwary ran in from long-off, dived forward and to his left to take a sharp catch, Sanga's gone
turns it towards square leg from the crease for a single, Kallis keeping it tight
drops that one in front of extra cover for a single
slower one bowled down the leg side, called a wide
goodish length outside off, chops that one towards point for a single, or wait, no run on offer there

Yusuf and his reach! White took that off a length and tried to clear long-on, he struck it well but didn't get the desired elevation on that, Yusuf was patrolling the long-on boundary, he moved to his left, timed his jump to perfection and retained his balance as he landed, superb catch, not too dissimilar to what Pollard did earlier in the tournament
gets front and across and pushes that one back to the bowler, something's got to give now
short of a good length, tried to run that down to third man, missed
slower legcutter, pushed it gently down towards long-on for one more
chips his first delivery just wide of extra cover for a single
pitched on a length on middle, quicker this time, driven towards long-on for a single
this time he makes room and punches that superbly between long-off and deep extra cover for a one bounce four, middled it this time
difficult to get those away but he does manage it this time, legcutter again, made room and cut it over point for four
slower legcutter, White didn't pick it initially, checked his shot as he played it to extra cover

bowled'im, the frustration and pressure was building on Parthiv and he's gone now, the cutter again and Parthiv went for the pull, didn't have much of a choice really, swung hard, missed and it struck middle
Parthiv misses out, on the pads and he was looking to flick it fine, missed and was struck on the pads
cut back in from outside off to catch White on the pads as he came forward to defend, they get another leg-bye
tries to force that one through the leg side, gets an inside edge onto the pads, a quick single

run-out attempt, pushed towards extra cover, Parthiv wanted the single, Morgan dived to his left and returned a throw to the keeper as Parthiv was sent back, Bisla took off the bails, the throw was a little wide and Parthiv was back in
Parthiv makes room, Kallis chases him and Parthiv tries to pull him over square leg, misses
difficult to get hold of those, the slower one, he's a tricky bowler to face when he takes the pace off, Parthiv strikes that on the bounce towards long-off
slower one pitched up outside off, Parthiv digs it out towards cover
the legcutter, pushes it past the diving bowler to long-on for a single
offcutter on middle, punched past the bowler into the deep for a single
slower one, shortish outside off, pushed past point for a single
six for White, he had decided this had to go, goodish length and he went through with the shot, clearing long-off, just about, he got his hands to it did Morgan but it went over him
Parthiv tries to help that on its way past the keeper, short outside off, can't make contact, the pressure builds
Parthiv finds the boundary, short and he pulls that well, pulls it square, wide of fine leg, for a one bounce four
short outside off, Parthiv senses the need for some urgency, makes room to crash that over point, misses
quick single, struck high on the pads as he moved across, some hesitation in the middle but Parthiv convinces White about the single, another leg-bye
White gets front and across to that slightly short delivery and pushes it towards midwicket, decides against the single
that pitched outside leg, moved across to flick it and missed, struck on the pads, they get a leg-bye
Parthiv turns that towards Narine at mid-on for a single
shortish on leg stump, punched towards deep midwicket for another single
Parthiv gets on the back foot and pushes it gently towards mid-on for a quick single
turns in from middle, worked towards deep midwicket for a single
on a length outside off and White drives it through the line towards mid-off
a bit more air on that one, Parthiv plays that from the crease, turns it past square leg for a single
Senanayake slips that one down the leg side, called a wide

run-out missed?, punched towards extra cover and they decide on a single, Senanayake picks up at extra cover and aims at the non-striker's end, misses, Parthiv, it seemed, was struggling to make it in time
ooh, got a slight leading edge as he tried to turn the face, just wide of extra cover for a quick single
was the carrom ball, short on the off, punched towards extra cover as it went the other way
flighted on the off, drives that one down towards long-off for a single
lands on a length outside off, square-drives that one towards point
the offspinner on middle, drives it through midwicket into the deep for a single
on middle and leg and he drives it wide of mid-on for a single
pushed away into the off side for a single

appeal for lbw, goes for the pull and misses, or maybe not, short from Senanayake, gets it to turn in slightly towards the batsman, he's got his own carrom ball, may have got an inside edge onto the pads, the height may have been an issue too
presses that one away for a single
round the wicket to the left-hander, slightly short outside leg stump, tries to knock it down really fine, is struck high on the pads
chopped into the off side for a single
wrists again, misfield at point, short of a length, cuts it past the fielder there for four more, Gambhir isn't happy, he's angry at that fumble at point
superbly done by Parthiv, slower one, landed on a length on middle and Parthiv wrisitly launches that over the bowler's head for six
angling in towards middle, turns it away past midwicket for a single into the deep for one more
goodish length on the off, gets a thick outside edge as he plays it towards point, a fumble there but they've decided against the single
Parthiv comes down the track and mistimes an attempted drive, gets it past the bowler for a single
angling in towards middle and leg, turns it through square leg for a single
shortish outside off, chops it wide of short third, no single on offer this time
flatter on the off, turned away towards wide long-on again for one more
not much turn, short, gets on the back foot and whips it to wide long-on
flighted on middle, drives it wide of long-on for a single
round the wicket again, floating it on middle, chipped towards long-off for a single
tossed up on middle and that's been driven back to the bowler
sliding on the pads and White flicks that away elegantly through square leg for a boundary, poor delivery and White doesn't waste it
slower one this time, the offcutter, Parthiv chased it and tried to drive it past extra cover, missed, they get a bye as the keeper fumbled
Parthiv chases a wide one, appeared to be in the slot outside off and he went hard at that one, didn't connect
angling in towards middle and leg, tries to clip that one fine, gets a leg-bye
angling in towards middle, White gets a little across and pushes it back down the pitch to the bowler
quick single for Parthiv, bowled on a good length on the off, plays it wide of mid-on
